stdout:
Getting Started
Add the design system to your project and start building.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

quick-start-with-ai       Quick Start with AI - Paste this into your AI coding tool and let it handle the setup:
install                   Install - Astryx requires React 19 or later: `react` and `react-dom` >= 19.0.0 are peer
                          dependencies of `@astryxdesign/core`.
upgrade                   Upgrade - Upgrade every Astryx package your app lists in one command, to the same release.
                          Each theme names the exact Core release it works with, so a theme left on an older release no
                          longer matches the new Core.
install-once              Install once, use everywhere - Install the CLI once for your computer too, and the astryx
                          command works in any folder, for you and for any coding agent, even before a project exists.
                          Inside a project, the project's own version still answers, so a global install never...
add-base-css-and-a-theme  Add base CSS and a theme - Import the reset and base styles in your global CSS. Then run `npx
                          @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add neutral`; the generated app module imports the theme's
                          production CSS and font CSS.
add-your-first-component  Add your first component - Import each component from its own entry, the path `npx
                          @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <Name>` prints. This keeps bundles small and makes intent
                          clear.
customize-with-stylex     Customize with StyleX - Astryx components support various styling solutions, from plain CSS
                          and `className` to Tailwind and CSS-in-JS. See `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling` for
                          the full guide. Astryx also has a deep integration with [StyleX](https://stylexjs.com/), an...
example-apps              Example Apps - For a full working project, clone one of the example apps from the repo. These
                          are complete setups with routing, theming, and components wired together.
explore-the-cli           Explore the CLI - The CLI is your reference for components, tokens, templates, and docs. For
                          reliable invocation (especially with AI assistants), add this script to your package.json:

Read one section: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs getting-started <section>
Read everything:  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs getting-started --full
Up: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs guides
Previous: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs browser-support
Next: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs is-my-code-good
